subject: Matemática

components.description_en: Convert between liters and cubic meters using the relationship 1 m³ = 1000 L
components.cc_component_description: Use ratios to convert between measurement units

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas envolvendo capacidade de recipientes usando equivalência litro-decímetro cúbico
